subject: Remit options & PO routing for Voltware onboarding
messages:
From: Ben Hale <ben.hale@voltware.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask: payment pathway while we finish vendor onboarding

Hi Sean / Monica,

Thanks for the warm welcome — Voltware is excited to get live with Redwood this quarter. Were working through your vendor onboarding checklist and wanted to surface a short-term request around payment timing and PO routing so we can avoid cashflow gaps during activation.

Summary of ask: can Redwood issue standard PO/net30 terms but make the first three invoices eligible for an accelerated remit (wed be willing to accept a small fee or discount to Redwood) so our implementation team can cover initial integration costs?

What weve attached: a sample first invoice and our procurement contact list.

Why: our billing cycles close mid-month; if Redwood pays invoices on standard net30 itll push our cash to month+2 and impact resource ramp.

Proposed temporary flow:
- Redwood issues PO with net30
- Voltware uploads invoice to Redwood payment portal and flags for "accelerated remit"
- Redwood ops triggers early remit for the first 3 invoices (manual approval)

If you need, we can route an ACH authorization or provide credit references. Happy to jump on a 20-min call this week to align.

Attachments: Voltware_Welcome_Invoice.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Ben Hale
Head of Finance, Voltware Inc.
ben.hale@voltware.com | +1 415-555-0182

---
Voltware Inc. | 600 Harrison St, San Francisco, CA
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Ben Hale <ben.hale@voltware.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: payment pathway while we finish vendor onboarding

Hi Ben — thanks for the clear note and for attaching the sample invoice.

Short answer: we can support a temporary accelerated remit for the first few invoices, but we need to confirm the PO and remittance routing so Finance can approve the manual workflow. Ive looped in Monica from Financial Ops and will loop in Marissa from Vendor Onboarding for PO-field alignment.

Next steps I need from you:
1) Please complete the vendor onboarding form (fillable link below) and attach W-9 + banking details for ACH.
2) Confirm which invoice IDs you want flagged for early remit (first three or specific invoice numbers).
3) If theres a preferred payment fee or discount youre proposing, include that in your reply so we can evaluate economics.

We use a temporary manual approval in Finance for early remits during onboarding. If everything looks good well: issue a PO (Net 30), route invoices to the manual early remit queue, and schedule payment within 7 business days for the flagged invoices. After the initial cohort we transition to standard AP processing.

Vendor form: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/vendor-form/voltware

Ill put Marissa on the next email. Happy to take a quick call — Tues/Thurs afternoon PST work best for me.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Initial ask: payment pathway while we finish vendor onboarding — PO field checklist

Hi Ben — welcome. Im Marissa (Vendor Onboarding). Sean summarized the process well; below is the PO/portal checklist so we can map Voltware fields to Redwoods PO intake and avoid delays.

Minimal items needed to enable the temporary early remit workflow:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (link).
- W-9 (US entities) or equivalent tax docs.
- Bank info for ACH (we store via KMS-backed vault).
- Preferred remittance email and invoice format (PDF or EDI).
- PO field mapping confirmation (see attached spreadsheet).

Notes on PO mapping (high level):
- Redwood PO required fields: PO#, ShipTo (account owner), BillTo (Finance), RemitEmail, ExpenseCode, ContractRef.
- For accelerated remit we add an ApprovalFlag = "EARLY-ONBOARD" and a TemporaryPaymentWindow = "7d" in the portal meta so Finance knows to prioritize.

Attachment: PO_Field_Mapping.xlsx (contains sample JSON key map and screenshots of our vendor portal).

If Voltware can confirm the field mapping and return the onboarding packet by end of week, Monica and I can get Finance to process the first two invoices as an exception while the portal automation is finalized.

Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa / Sean — thanks, and appreciate the quick turnaround.

Weve completed the onboarding packet and attached the W-9 and bank routing. Per your mapping doc: Voltware will populate Redwoods PO# and include RemitEmail=payments@voltware.com in every invoice.

Confirming the execution plan:
- Wed like the first three invoice IDs (VOLT-001, VOLT-002, VOLT-003) to be placed in the "EARLY-ONBOARD" queue.
- We propose a 1.5% early payment fee for 7-day settlement (open to negotiation).
- We will submit the documents via the vendor form today: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/vendor-form/voltware

If youre good with that, Monica — can Finance approve the two-week exception for the first three invoices and confirm payment window? If you need, we can route a short DocuSign ACH authorization.

Thanks again — looking forward to going live.

Best,
Ben Hale
Head of Finance, Voltware Inc.
ben.hale@voltware.com
